# dsh-skill-hub
English（英文）— 点击在本页展开 / 收起，无需跳转 **In-GUI skill hub for [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh).** Browse the full local skill catalog from the official `ctx.skills` registry, toggle skills on/off, inspect their bodies, understand why a skill is missing, and scaffold new ones — all from the dsh web GUI. > A skill manager beyond the read-only browser.
